_about: The TCS New York City Marathon's street closures, from the City's own notice (NYC Citywide Event Coordination and Management, a PDF table by borough: street, boundaries, restriction, time), read by fetch_marathon.py into raw/closures/marathon_<year>.json and placed on the street centerline by fetch_closures.py as an event. NYRR publishes no course file, so no course line is drawn. The notice usually appears in the last week of October; until then fetch_marathon.py finds nothing for this year and the map shows no marathon. 'test' is a past year's notice, fetched only to check the parser.
name: TCS New York City Marathon
